name: SSH Terminal
description: A secure SSH terminal for interactive sessions, SFTP file transfer, remote commands, and guarded server operations.
releaseNotes: First official store release: interactive SSH terminal with PTY, SFTP file transfer, remote command execution, sudo with approval guards, host key management, and multi-language UI.
